decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to use the combo of Omniscience along with several other cards to create a powerful and synergistic strategy. This includes utilizing cards like Fallaji Archaeologist and Marang River Regent to control the board, while also having ways to protect your combo with cards like Spell Pierce. The deck focuses on ramping up to play Omniscience as quickly as possible, enabling you to play spells for free and overwhelm your opponent with powerful cards like Roiling Dragonstorm. The deck also includes options for card draw and mana fixing to ensure consistency in executing the combo effectively.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on maintaining a strong board presence with a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By playing efficient creatures like Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and Overlord of the Balemurk, the deck can quickly pressure the opponent while also using cards like Insidious Roots and Dredger's Insight to disrupt their game plan. The deck also includes support cards like Scavenging Ooze and Osteomancer Adept to control the battlefield and keep the pressure on the opponent. With a good balance of aggression and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells, focusing on dealing damage quickly and efficiently. The deck includes a mix of creatures with evasive abilities, card draw spells, and burn spells to control the board and maintain aggression. The mana base is optimized for casting spells of both blue and red colors consistently. By playing cards like Sleight of Hand and Opt, the deck aims to maintain card advantage and tempo throughout the game, allowing for powerful swings in momentum.
